'''B.1.N.G.O.''' is an Automaton that offers [[Simulation Training]] at [[Startorch Academy - Square]] in [[Lahai-Roi]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''B.1.N.G.O.''' Listen up! I'm the Battle Interface for the Next-Gen Operations, not a trash can! ...Ahem, well, not just a trash can.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* B.1.N.G.O.'s current body was supposed to be temporary but it refused to transfer over to its new body.<ref>[[Boltzmann#Dialogue|Boltzmann's Dialogue]]</ref>
